policy.presenting_symptom: Network of fine surface cracks on hot-rolled strip, concentrated mid-width, a few percent of coils per shift.

candidate_causes.label: Reheat furnace zone temperature overshoot (control loop on manual override)
Uneven strip/roll cooling causing thermal cycling
Work roll surface thermal fatigue (roll change overdue)
Residual Cu/Sn in heat chemistry causing hot shortness
Pre-existing slab surface cracks from continuous casting
Finishing mill exit temperature below aim

tests.label: Review reheat furnace temperature log vs setpoint
Inspect cooling header flow and spray pattern
Inspect work roll surface and roll-change log
Check heat chemistry certificate (Cu, Sn, S)
Pull caster slab surface inspection report
Review finishing-mill exit temperature trend
Metallographic section of the crack (morphology, oxide)

policy.presenting_symptom: Sliver-like and spot defects from non-metallic particles trapped in the strip, intermittent across heats.

candidate_causes.label: Ladle slag carry-over into the tundish
Mold powder entrapment from level fluctuation

tests.label: Review ladle slag-off and tapping practice log
Inspect tundish/SEN refractory wear
Check argon shroud/seal integrity and nitrogen pickup
Review mold level fluctuation and powder consumption
Review argon stirring time/flow log
Review Al addition and dissolved-oxygen readings
SEM/EDS composition of the inclusion

policy.presenting_symptom: Localised patches on the strip surface that look different in shade or texture from the surroundings.

candidate_causes.label: Roll lubricant spray fault (blocked or uneven)
Contaminated or oxidised work roll surface
Roll crown/profile wear causing uneven reduction
Local residual scale from incomplete descaling

tests.label: Inspect lubricant spray nozzles and flow
Inspect roll surface condition after the campaign
Check coolant spray pattern and header pressure
Measure roll profile against crown spec
Macro-etch slab sample for segregation
Check descaler pressure and nozzle condition
Map patch pattern along the strip (periodic vs random)

policy.presenting_symptom: Multiple shallow pits near the strip edge after descaling or pickling, roughly 1 in 20 coils affected.

candidate_causes.label: Descaler nozzle cleaning missed (maintenance scheduling gap)
Descaler/rinse water chemistry more corrosive than spec
Coil storage humidity causing pre-existing corrosion
Damaged work roll surface imprinting pits
Foreign particles rolled into the strip
Excess pickling time or acid concentration

tests.label: Review descaler maintenance and work-order history
Sample and test water pH and chlorides
Check coil-yard humidity and dwell-time log
Measure pit spacing vs roll circumference
Inspect entry cleanliness, filters and wipers
Review pickling speed and acid concentration log

policy.presenting_symptom: Dark scale marks pressed into the strip surface after hot rolling, scattered over the width.

candidate_causes.label: Excessive reheat dwell producing thick scale
Long delay between descaling and rolling (re-scaling)

tests.label: Review descaler pressure trend
Inspect descaler nozzles during stop
Review furnace dwell-time log for affected slabs
Check heat chemistry for Si level
Review furnace O2/combustion air log
Review descale-to-rolling transfer time
Cross-section of scale layer (thickness/type)

policy.presenting_symptom: Linear surface marks on strip after finishing, horizontal or slanting, on several coils.

candidate_causes.label: Debris or build-up on contact rolls
Sharp edge burr from slitting scoring adjacent wraps

tests.label: Check idler roll rotation along the line
Check guide alignment and wear surfaces
Inspect contact rolls for debris
Audit coil handling and transport log
Measure slit-edge burr height
Classify scratch direction and continuity

policy.presenting_symptom: Half-circle material loss at the strip edge after shearing, appearing on repeated cuts.

candidate_causes.label: Strip tracking offset at the shear
Hydraulic pressure drop at the shear

tests.label: Measure blade gap against spec
Inspect blade edges for wear/chips
Check strip tracking and centre-line control
Verify shear timing against line speed
Review incoming gauge trend
Review hydraulic pressure log at the shear

policy.presenting_symptom: Folds or wrinkles on forged parts from excessive local deformation, repeating on a die set.

candidate_causes.label: Material too soft (low carbon) for the deformation

tests.label: Check hardness/chemistry of the billet

Measure preform dimensions vs drawing

Check weld cooling flow/temperature
